title: FAQ Accordion Generator
description: Build an accessible FAQ accordion (ARIA, keyboard-friendly) — live preview plus HTML, CSS and JS.
howto: Enter each FAQ as a block: question line, then answer lines, blank line between FAQs.
Pick the accent color and icon style.
Test the live preview — it is fully clickable.
Copy the code or download the self-contained faq.html.
